marta_cs: Week0 status check for HarborFox private/VPC deploy — audit pipeline is filling the DLQ. S3 objects present but forwarder logs show DecryptionFailure. Suspect KMS grants or egress/proxy blocking KMS calls. @emma_harborfox can you confirm VPC endpoints and proxy rules?

emma_harborfox: Subnets are private with a corporate proxy/NAT. We see SQS DLQ messages with error 'DecryptionFailure: AccessDenied'. KMS key is customer-managed in us-east-1 (alias/harborfox-cmk). No KMS endpoint configured today.

devon_infra: If the agent tries to hit kms.us-east-1.amazonaws.com and the proxy blocks it you'll see exactly that. Either add an interface VPC endpoint for KMS or allow the kms+sts hostnames in the proxy ACL. Also validate the forwarder IAM role has kms:Decrypt.

rachel_eng: Minimal KMS key policy we recommend: ```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/redwood-forwarder"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],"Resource":"*"}]}```

siva_sre: One more gotcha: EncryptionContext mismatch causes DecryptionFailure even when policy is fine. Check CloudWatch/agent logs for EncryptionContext keys and ensure the forwarder supplies the expected context.

emma_harborfox: We applied the forwarder role to the key policy but errors persist. NAT flow logs show blocked egress to kms.us-east-1.amazonaws.com (proxy dropped). We can either open outbound to AWS control plane or create a VPC endpoint. Which is recommended?

devon_infra: Recommended: create AWS KMS interface VPC endpoint in the VPC (quick and least-privileged). If proxy must remain, add explicit allow for the AWS control plane hostnames + sts. For temporary unblock you can create a KMS Grant to the forwarder role and record the grant id.

marta_cs: Action items: 1) @emma create KMS interface endpoint or whitelist kms+sts in proxy; 2) @emma paste one DLQ sample message here so we can confirm EncryptionContext; 3) @rachel add an EncryptionContext troubleshooting snippet to the runbook; 4) I'll mark account health yellow->red until ingestion stabilizes; renewal risk = medium-high if not resolved in 72h.

opsbot: Ticket CS-7622 created: "HarborFox audit ingestion DLQ  KMS/egress/proxy" https://redwood.internal/tickets/CS-7622

emma_harborfox: Creating endpoint now and adding a temporary grant. Will paste DLQ sample in ~30m.

rachel_eng: Quick decrypt CLI to validate object locally: `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://blob.enc --key-id alias/harborfox-cmk --query Plaintext --output text | base64 --decode > /tmp/log`. If decryption fails locally, check key grants and EncryptionContext.

siva_sre: Postmortem suggestion: onboarding checklist should include proxy ACL rules for AWS control plane and a KMS endpoint step for private deploys. I'll add that item.

marta_cs: Thanks — monitoring. 48h/72h checkpoints scheduled; will escalate renewal risk if not green.
